# steps

1. log in
2. if a what's new popup appears, close it
3. drag the card `Fix login redirect` into the Done column and drop it above the first card there
4. drag `Mobile navigation` to the bottom of the To do column
5. rename the card `Onboarding emails` to `Welcome emails` right on the board
6. open the menu of the second card in the third column and move it to In progress
7. use the Overdue filter to show only overdue tasks, then reschedule the overdue task to next week from its badge
8. switch the filter off again
9. press Ctrl+K, choose Move task, pick `Logo refresh`, then choose Move to To do
10. press Ctrl+K again, type `insights` and press enter, and wait for the team velocity chart to load
11. open the Activity feed and keep scrolling until the Release notes v2.0 item appears
12. open the workspace menu, go to Switch project and choose Atlas
13. open Settings and use the keyboard only to turn on Compact cards and Dark mode
